description: Lean on the Carrera del Darro parapet east of the Puente de Cabrera and look west along the river at night. Lamplight trembles on the water below.

prompts.prompt-r1.txt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create one original high-detail 16:9 landscape scene, documentary tourist eye-level photographic realism, an AI artistic interpretation of Carrera del Darro, Granada. Real Carrera del Darro at Puente de Cabrera in Granada's Albaicín. Public eye-level camera just east of the bridge looking west: narrow shallow river channel below camera, low water with exposed irregular stony edges and green banks; one small single-span rough-stone bridge crosses midground diagonally from left bank to street on right, low solid stone parapet, one rounded arch. Raised cobbled narrow street on RIGHT separated from river by knee-high continuous rough stone parapet, receding pale ochre and cream 3–4storey old facades with small wrought-iron balconies on right; leafy shadowed opposite bank left. Small traditional wall lanterns produce restrained warm pools of light and subtle water reflections; distant facades in shadow. Not a broad canal, no gondolas, no wide grand bridge, no Ronda gorge, no invented cathedral or Alhambra skyline in this west-facing crop. Main bridge and channel centrally composed inside central45%width; preserve bridge span and arch in portraitcrop while some outer street edges may crop. Dry uneven paving, not glossy rain-soaked. Trees have late-September foliage, exact arrangement interpretative.
Scenario: 23 September 2026 · 21:52 Europe/Madrid; full NIGHT, sun elevation -20.76 degrees, azimuth 286.9 degrees below horizon; no sunlight, no dusk orange horizon. Fresh Open-Meteo model: 21.4C, cloud cover 1%, precipitation 0mm, wind 5.8km/h; model data not an on-site observation. Sky near-black with very faint sparse cloud, no moon or visible stars. Artificial lighting modest with realistic shadow falloff; preserve stone/glass detail without fake HDR. No rain, fog, reflections on dry pavement, obvious people, contemporary artwork focal subject, logos, promotional lettering, or fantasy details. Make a coherent real place with straight architectural verticals, plausible spatial scale and non-repeated surface texture. Leave bottom 15% visually quiet for later captions. IMPORTANT: NO TEXT, no signature, no watermark in this source; exact labels will be typeset on the exported masters later. Wide environmental composition with main subject fully in the central portrait-safe crop as described, do not enlarge subject to fill entire landscape width. Photographic tonal range, no cinematic golden hour.
